title: The *nearest* plant is a habit
subtitle: Serve each distributor from its lowest landed cost source · Illustrative numbers

stages.name: List
stages.desc: Every distributor in the rows, every plant or depot in the columns.

stages.name: Cost each cell
stages.desc: Plant A: 400 + 60 = 460. Plant B: 410 + 30 = 440 per case.

stages.name: Check capacity
stages.desc: The cheapest cell only wins if the plant has the volume and the SKUs.

stages.name: Re-route
stages.desc: Move the distributor, then re-check the matrix every quarter.

takeaway: Landed cost per case = ex-plant cost per case + freight per case

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
